title: Armenia Company Profile
description: Country-specific company profile for Armenia. The universal key is the 8-digit TIN (ՀՎՀՀ / HVHH), shared by the State Register and the State Revenue Committee (SRC); the State Register also issues a state registration number. The authoritative State Register of Legal Entities (e-register.am, Ministry of Justice) is protected by Radware Bot Manager (planning-only — no open bulk/API). The SRC taxpayer search (src.am) is browser-public per-TIN, returning taxpayer name and status (and VAT status). Listed securities come from the Armenia Securities Exchange (AMX) by ISIN (AM...), a JS SPA with no clean public API. The national open-data portal (data.gov.am) did not resolve, and the civic Open Data Armenia (CKAN) carries no company register. Language Armenian (+ English); currency AMD. Director/founders (register) and individual taxpayers (SRC) are personal data — redact. No registry per-company values were captured.

tin_hvhh.description: 8-digit TIN (ՀՎՀՀ/HVHH) — tax id and universal join key (register + SRC).

legal_name.description: Company name. SRC taxpayer name (browser) / State Register name (authoritative).

legal_form.description: State Register legal form (planning-only): ՍՊԸ (LLC), ԲԲԸ/ՓԲԸ (OJSC/CJSC).

taxpayer_status.description: SRC taxpayer status (active/inactive) — TAX status, not registration status.

registered_location.description: Registered address — State Register only (bot-protected; planning-only).

officers.description: Director (State Register). PERSONAL DATA (personal-data law) — REDACT. Planning-only (bot-protected).

owners.description: Founders / participants (State Register). PERSONAL DATA when natural persons — REDACT. Planning-only.

listing.description: Present only for AMX-listed companies (browser-public SPA).
